tasks.title: HTTP request edge cases
tasks.objective: Read Handler and existing tests. Add nonduplicative HTTP regression cases for malformed request framing, Host/Origin checks and unsupported methods using temporary loopback servers. Assert the documented contract; isolate reproduced defects instead of weakening expectations.
tasks.acceptance: Targeted unittest command with exact cases/results; no leaked sockets, no production server changes.

tasks.title: Import rejection and identity matrix
tasks.objective: Cover schema/wrapper/type rejection and evidence/identity isolation at import boundaries missing from existing tests. Use synthetic fixtures and temporary data; preserve source objects.
tasks.acceptance: Targeted unittest passes for supported behavior; any newly reproduced contract defect is reported separately.

tasks.title: Unicode and export boundary regression
tasks.objective: Exercise Unicode, long valid text and adversarial names through JSON, Markdown and ZIP export. Assert semantic preservation and safe archive paths, not brittle byte snapshots. Avoid existing HTML-escape coverage duplication.
tasks.acceptance: Focused tests demonstrate readable Unicode and safe archive members; no owner data used.

tasks.title: Competing revision writes
tasks.objective: Exercise simultaneous revisioned writes and concurrent reads against temporary Store instances, with barriers and bounded joins. Verify one winner, explicit conflicts and consistent project/history. Do not infer hosted multiuser support.
tasks.acceptance: Deterministic tests with bounded execution; report concurrency assumptions and exact results.

tasks.title: Backup recovery rehearsal utility
tasks.objective: Implement a standard-library self-contained rehearsal that creates synthetic temporary projects/history, closes storage, copies backup, restores to a fresh temporary directory and verifies integrity. Never touch the default database or accept an overwrite of owner data.
tasks.acceptance: Runnable documented rehearsal and meaningful failure test; project and history readback checked.

tasks.title: Pinned Skillz shelf validator
tasks.objective: Build a standalone validator for the actual app/data/skills.json schema, unique safe IDs, HTTPS source URLs and full pinned revisions. Use synthetic invalid fixtures. Do not fetch or edit Skillz, handwave remote availability, require exact optional keys or install dependencies.
tasks.acceptance: Current shelf validated, malformed fixtures rejected, useful nonzero exit diagnostics and --help.

tasks.title: Source allowlist failure regression
tasks.objective: Add missing-file and traversal/encoding boundary tests for the five allowlisted sources using a temporary synthetic root. Never modify canon or broaden the source allowlist.
tasks.acceptance: Specific allowed/missing/disallowed assertions with negative controls, no duplicated source happy-path test.

tasks.title: Component graph and collection boundaries
tasks.objective: Test valid deep/branched dependency graphs near declared limits and invalid unknown, self or cyclic references beyond existing tests. Cover collection/type bounds with no huge stress load or implementation-mirroring tests.
tasks.acceptance: Focused tests based on the public validation contract, bounded runtime and explicit boundary results.

tasks.title: Repeatable browser authoring journey
tasks.objective: Use an already available browser driver to implement a repeatable create, edit, save, reopen, export and import smoke journey against a temporary loopback app. Discover installed runtimes first; no package install. Keep browser evidence local, synthetic and source-SHA identified.
tasks.acceptance: Assertions check visible outcomes and persisted values. If driver unavailable report NOT RUN; no fake DOM substitute claimed as browser proof.

tasks.title: Exported web starter resilience
tasks.objective: Export a synthetic web-tool ZIP and exercise add/complete/reopen/filter/reload plus malformed or unavailable browser storage with an installed browser driver. Create a reusable focused runner and reproduce failures without modifying web_starter in server.py.
tasks.acceptance: Actual exported code is executed, assertions distinguish supported behavior from defects; no weakening assertions or new dependencies.

tasks.title: Custom GPT pilot kit
tasks.objective: Author one useful synthetic Glee-fully Custom GPT draft compatible with the actual import schema, using the local scaffold and current template. Include realistic expected-use, missing-input and boundary cases plus manual target-environment evaluation steps. Mark all results not-run.
tasks.acceptance: Validate/import/export with temporary Store or API; authored expected results never become observed passes or canon/PME claims.

tasks.title: Agent Skill pilot kit
tasks.objective: Author one useful synthetic Agent Skill draft with bounded trigger, inputs, method, checks and handoff, compatible with current importer. Use repository skill guidance; do not create or promote an actual Skillz package.
tasks.acceptance: Temporary import/export verified, meaningful acceptance cases not-run, generated SKILL.md reviewed with clear target validation steps.

tasks.title: Workflow pilot kit
tasks.objective: Author a realistic synthetic Glee-fully workflow with roles, dependency graph, exception path and acceptance cases. Match importer schema and explain how an owner can evaluate the exported workflow manually.
tasks.acceptance: Temporary import/export and graph validation pass; no claim that a workflow execution engine exists or pilot was owner-tested.

tasks.title: Web-tool pilot kit
tasks.objective: Author a synthetic domain-specific record-management brief compatible with the existing starter. Separate already implemented generic behaviors from domain customizations still needed. All acceptance observations remain not-run.
tasks.acceptance: Temporary import/export verified; a usable adaptation checklist and no claim of arbitrary application generation.

tasks.title: Restorable revision design
tasks.objective: Design the smallest viable immutable snapshot and restore contract from the current Store/history schema. Cover restore-as-new-revision, evidence invalidation, archive semantics, old data and failure rollback. No database migration or runtime implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Source-bound proposal with acceptance scenarios, explicit decisions and limitations; no claim of implemented restoration.

tasks.title: Schema migration design
tasks.objective: Specify a minimal transactional SQLite migration strategy for the current schema, legacy detection, supported/future versions, backups and failure behavior. Coordinate assumptions with F15 via source references; do not implement a migration or modify owner data.
tasks.acceptance: Concrete version transitions and rollback/recovery test cases, proposals clearly labeled, no conflicting runtime assumptions hidden.

tasks.title: Evaluation provenance contract
tasks.objective: Define a compact proposal attaching observations to tested specification revision, environment, observer/time and artifact references. Account for existing evidence invalidation, imported evidence reset, synthetic data and privacy. Do not change canon or readiness rules.
tasks.acceptance: Example valid/invalid records and stale-evidence cases; distinguish user claims from independently verified observations.

tasks.title: Reciprocal mentoring exchange contract
tasks.objective: Define a small versioned pattern packet with source SHA, regional overrides, compatibility, feedback and adoption evidence. Include a synthetic example grounded in Glee-fully. Skillz shared, FoundRy runtimes/data separate; no sibling changes.
tasks.acceptance: Readable optional exchange format with privacy and conflict cases, no auto-sync or adoption claims.

tasks.title: Export to child-repository handoff
tasks.objective: Map current four package types to a reviewable child-repository handoff using actual ZIP contents and local governance. Explain inputs, required review, target validation and public-data exclusions. No remote repo creation or publication.
tasks.acceptance: Exact existing export member names verified and one practical end-to-end handoff example labeled synthetic.

tasks.title: Browser error recovery regression
tasks.objective: Build a focused installed-driver browser runner for failed save, stale-revision conflict, invalid import and unsaved navigation. Keep separate from F09 happy-path journey. Verify draft preservation, busy-state recovery and truthful errors. No edits to app.js.
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible assertions with temporary server/data; report real defects as findings and unavailable tools as NOT RUN.

tasks.title: FoundRy feature-page contract
tasks.objective: Add targeted source regression checks for the existing foundry/index.html route, canonical URL, source CTA, local-only boundary, metadata and current sitemap/search inclusion. Inspect existing tests and do not duplicate whole-site QA.
tasks.acceptance: Focused test with clear diagnostics; no generated data updates, hardcoded stale total counts or arbitrary copy snapshots.

tasks.title: FoundRy local-start visitor walkthrough
tasks.objective: Write a concise source-bound visitor guide from website explanation to public FoundRy repo and local setup, private working data and exports. Read FoundRy current public docs read-only. Preserve Glee-fully voice and distinguish this guide from a hosted builder.
tasks.acceptance: All commands and paths source-verified; no invented installation step, account requirement or hosted capability.

tasks.title: FoundRy visitor journey prototype
tasks.objective: Create one isolated, locally reviewable FoundRy feature-page improvement prototype using existing website CSS/tokens and source-backed copy. Make local-source/setup path clearer and return path to Toolbox explicit. Label prototype; do not modify production HTML, CSS, indexes or deploy it.
tasks.acceptance: Render at desktop and narrow viewport if installed browser available; links and keyboard order checked, no new brand palette/dependencies or publication claim.

tasks.title: Universe link relationship regression
tasks.objective: Add a narrow source-based link contract test for the relationships actually declared on the FoundRy feature page and existing universe data. Check exact intended destinations/attributes, shared Skillz and separate FoundRys without requiring every page link to every site.
tasks.acceptance: Negative fixture proves changed or unsafe destinations detected. No remote requests, whole-site duplicate audit or generated data edits.

tasks.title: Search-engine submission handoff
tasks.objective: Prepare the roadmap's sitemap-submission handoff using CNAME, sitemap, robots and canonical source. Verify current submission instructions only against official Google/Bing docs if needed. Separate verified local prerequisites from account access and unperformed submissions.
tasks.acceptance: Exact sitemap URL, bounded preflight and owner action sequence, source links; do not claim access, submission, indexing or ranking improvements.

tasks.title: FoundRy accessibility regression
tasks.objective: Build a focused installed-driver checker for the newly added FoundRy page: heading/landmark structure, CTA names, FAQ keyboard operation, focus visibility and narrow overflow. Reuse existing site runner patterns; do not repeat full 504-case suite or rewrite CSS.
tasks.acceptance: Visible behavior assertions with current source SHA; human screen-reader testing explicitly NOT RUN, concrete defects reported for later assigned fixes.
